meta.provenance: Illustrative expert-elicited priors for software testing; not validated Sri Lankan prevalence estimates.
meta.syntheticBanner: SYNTHETIC DATA - GENERATED BY A BAYESIAN NETWORK FROM ASSUMED PARAMETERS. CONTAINS NO REAL STUDENT, FAMILY OR SCHOOL INFORMATION. MUST NOT BE USED TO VALIDATE THE MODEL THAT GENERATED IT.
meta.caseloadNote: 240 synthetic students, forward-sampled from the baseline network (seed 20250725). No real student data. The tool scores them with the amended network, so the cohort is not drawn from the model doing the scoring.
meta.guardrailMessage: Refusing to intervene on a protected or immutable characteristic. do() is restricted to modifiable school and household factors. Immutable or protected characteristics such as neurotype are never valid intervention targets.
meta.caveat: Decision-support only. Not a diagnosis, not a prediction about this individual, and not a basis for any automated action. Requires human review.

nodes.name: Sector
nodes.label: School sector
nodes.whyNotActionable: Where the school is. Changes with policy and infrastructure, not casework.

nodes.name: Economic_Strain
nodes.label: Household economic strain
nodes.whyNotActionable: Real and important, but not something a school can change directly. It is a reason for a welfare referral, not a school intervention.

nodes.name: Parent_Education
nodes.label: Parent's own schooling
nodes.whyNotActionable: A fact about the parent's own past. Acting on it is not possible and treating it as a deficit is not acceptable.

nodes.name: Parent_Availability
nodes.label: Parent present at home
nodes.whyNotActionable: Often migration for work. The school can work around it — see study support — but cannot change it.

nodes.name: Neuro_Type
nodes.label: Neurotype
nodes.whyNotActionable: A characteristic of the student, never a target. The model refuses to estimate what would happen 'if this student were not autistic', and the network has no direct arrow from neurotype to leaving school — only arrows through how the school responds.

action.action: Refer household duties to welfare, with a family visit
action.detail: The duties usually exist for a reason. Address the reason — income, a sick relative, childcare — before asking the family to change.
Season ticket, shared van place, or a route change. Confirm the journey actually works in the monsoon, not just on paper.

action.action: Refer for school meals and a health check
action.detail: Meals and health screening are separate programmes with separate owners.
action.caveat: This variable bundles hunger with illness (report critique C7), so the estimate below has no single real-world action behind it. Treat the number as indicative only and split the referral in practice.

action.action: Set up study support outside the home
action.detail: Supervised study hour at school, a volunteer tutor, or a take-home pack. Do not depend on a parent who is not there.

action.action: Repair and maintain toilets and water supply
action.detail: A school-level fix, not a student-level one. Affects every student in the building, and older girls most.

action.action: Reduce sensory load in the classroom
action.detail: Quieter seating, permission to leave the room, a low-stimulus space at interval. Benefits the whole class, so needs no label on one student.

action.action: Put a learning accommodation plan in place
action.detail: Written plan: seating, extra time, instructions given in writing, a named adult to check in weekly.

action.action: Open the anti-bullying and peer-inclusion protocol
action.detail: Investigate, act on the behaviour of the students doing it, and build a peer group around the student. Do not make the target change class.

action.action: Assign teaching resources or relief staff
action.detail: School-level. Under-resourcing shows up as individual student risk, which is a reason to fund the school, not to flag the child.

nodes.name: Support_Mismatch
nodes.label: Support does not match need
nodes.whyNotActionable: A summary of other factors, not a lever of its own. Act on the accommodation and sensory factors that feed it.

nodes.name: School_Distress
nodes.label: Distress at school
nodes.whyNotActionable: A signal, not a lever. Act on its causes.

nodes.name: Access_Barrier
nodes.label: Practical barrier to attending
nodes.whyNotActionable: A signal, not a lever. Act on transport, duties, food and health.

nodes.name: Previous_Attendance
nodes.label: Attendance last term
nodes.whyNotActionable: A record of what happened. It cannot be changed, only responded to.

nodes.name: Current_Academic_Performance
nodes.label: Academic performance
nodes.whyNotActionable: An outcome of support, not a lever to pull directly.

nodes.name: Psychological_Attendance_Barrier
nodes.label: Reluctance to come in
nodes.whyNotActionable: A signal, not a lever. Act on distress and bullying.

nodes.name: Current_Attendance
nodes.label: Attendance this term
nodes.whyNotActionable: The thing we are trying to protect, not a lever. Marking a student present does not keep them in school.

nodes.name: School_Engagement
nodes.label: Engagement at school
nodes.whyNotActionable: The thing we are trying to protect, not a lever.
